metadata.label: Ontario Health and Physical Education Grade 6 curriculum

ontario-hpe-g6-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Health and Physical Education Grade 6 - Overall Expectations
ontario-hpe-g6-all-strands.documentVersion: Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1–8: Health and Physical Education (2019)

standards.summaryText: apply, to the best of their ability, a range of social-emotional learning skills as they acquire knowledge and skills in connection with the expectations in the Active Living, Movement Competence, and Healthy Living strands for this grade
standards.officialOutcomeText: apply, to the best of their ability, a range of social-emotional learning skills as they acquire knowledge and skills in connection with the expectations in the Active Living, Movement Competence, and Healthy Living strands for this grade

standards.summaryText: participate actively and regularly in a wide variety of physical activities, and demonstrate an understanding of how physical activity can be incorporated into their daily lives;
standards.officialOutcomeText: participate actively and regularly in a wide variety of physical activities, and demonstrate an understanding of how physical activity can be incorporated into their daily lives;

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the importance of being physically active, and apply physical fitness concepts and practices that contribute to healthy, active living;
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the importance of being physically active, and apply physical fitness concepts and practices that contribute to healthy, active living;

standards.summaryText: demonstrate responsibility for their own safety and the safety of others as they participate in physical activities.
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate responsibility for their own safety and the safety of others as they participate in physical activities.

standards.unit: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies
standards.strand: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies
standards.summaryText: perform movement skills, demonstrating an understanding of the basic requirements of the skills and applying movement concepts as appropriate, as they engage in a variety of physical activities;
standards.officialOutcomeText: perform movement skills, demonstrating an understanding of the basic requirements of the skills and applying movement concepts as appropriate, as they engage in a variety of physical activities;
standards.curriculumFocus: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies
standards.moduleLabel: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies

standards.unit: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies
standards.strand: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies
standards.summaryText: apply movement strategies appropriately, demonstrating an understanding of the components of a variety of physical activities, in order to enhance their ability to participate successfully in those activities.
standards.officialOutcomeText: apply movement strategies appropriately, demonstrating an understanding of the components of a variety of physical activities, in order to enhance their ability to participate successfully in those activities.
standards.curriculumFocus: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies
standards.moduleLabel: Movement Competence: Skills, Concepts, and Strategies

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of factors that contribute to healthy development;
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of factors that contribute to healthy development;

standards.summaryText: demonstrate the ability to apply health knowledge and social-emotional learning skills to make reasoned decisions and take appropriate actions relating to their personal health and well-being;
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate the ability to apply health knowledge and social-emotional learning skills to make reasoned decisions and take appropriate actions relating to their personal health and well-being;

standards.summaryText: demonstrate the ability to make connections that relate to health and well-being – how their choices and behaviours affect both themselves and others, and how factors in the world around them affect their own and others’ health and well-being.
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate the ability to make connections that relate to health and well-being – how their choices and behaviours affect both themselves and others, and how factors in the world around them affect their own and others’ health and well-being.
